messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MPA / evaluation kit handoff — Cedar Labs (staged access & limited-consumption plan)

Hi Nadia —

Good to meet you on the call earlier. As discussed, we want to send over a small evaluation kit (prompt pack + 50 curated testcases) for Cedar Labs to run a short acceptance pass against Redwood Inference. To keep this lightweight and compliant with both teams' policies, proposed approach: 

- Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft attached (see proposed milestones & acceptance gates).
- Provide Cedar with ephemeral access tokens and an ingestion runbook for a 2-week sandbox window.
- Prompt pack and testcase CSV will be delivered under a restricted-use license: no redistribution, no production inference outside the sandbox, and automatic revocation after the window.
- Redwood to provide a short checklist for redaction/PII handling and an audit log export at the end of the window.

Could you confirm Cedar's legal ok with the restricted-use clauses and whether you need an escrow path for the assets? If yes, we can route the MPA to DocuSign and add the escrow terms.

Next steps we propose:
1) You confirm legal's comments by EOD Monday 6/16.
2) We provision tokens and upload prompt pack to the shared Drive on 6/17.
3) Acceptance run 6/18–6/30, with Redwood providing evaluation metrics and traces for the agreed prompt set.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_cedarlabs_v1.pdf (draft), sample-testcases-50.csv (sample)

Thanks —
Logan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MPA / evaluation kit handoff — Cedar Labs (staged access & limited-consumption plan)

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the summary and the draft MAP. Legal flagged two items we need clarified before we can sign:

1) Asset custody: we prefer an escrowed copy of the prompt pack that is accessible only upon explicit agreement if either party loses access. Is Redwood open to adding a short escrow clause?
2) Data residency & logs: Cedar requires that audit logs and traces of our queries remain in the US region and retained for 90 days. Can Redwood commit to that retention window for the evaluation traces?

Operationally Tom (cc'ed) will coordinate the sandbox ingestion steps. We also need confirmation that the ephemeral tokens won't allow export of the dataset itself (only inference calls).

We can get back with legal redlines by Monday afternoon (6/16).

Best,
Nadia Alvarez
Head of ML Ops | Cedar Labs
nadia@cedarlabs.ai

Hi Nadia —

Appreciate the quick review. Short answers below and a couple of edits we can make to the MAP: 

- Escrow: yes, Redwood is fine adding an escrow line that stipulates encrypted storage of the prompt pack with access only on defined triggers. We will add the escrow contact block to the MPA and route to DocuSign.
- Logs & retention: we can retain evaluation traces in the US region and provide a 90-day retention export. We'll include a clause that the logs are access-controlled and delivered as an export (no raw dataset download).
- Ephemeral tokens: tokens are scoped to inference-only calls and do not provide any dataset download capability. We will include an additional technical appendix describing token scopes and endpoint behaviors.

Marissa will own the operational checklist and provisioning timeline — Marissa, can you confirm readiness to upload the prompt pack and create sandbox tokens on 6/17?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
